nodes.label: OLMo-2 0325 32B
nodes.rationale: OLMo-2 0325 32B model trained with this repo. The OLMo-2 7B and 13B models were instead trained with the old OLMo trainer and their configs/scripts are not compatible with this repo.

nodes.label: OLMo-2 Stage 2 Annealing (Dolmino-mix-0324)
nodes.rationale: Two-stage pretraining: stage 1 on mostly web-based data (OLMo-mix-1124, ~6T tokens), stage 2 anneals on a smaller amount of high-quality targeted data (Dolmino-mix-0324). Multiple stage-2 ingredients differ by random seed and token budget (seed 1110 100B; seed 2662 100B; seed 2662 300B); the final released model is produced by averaging weights (souping) in Python with no config.
